search_text: published ZDI-14-015 ZDI-CAN-1622 GE Proficy CIMPLICITY gefebt.exe File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-02-13 CVE-2014-0750 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-0750 7.5 ['GE'] ['Proficy CIMPLICITY'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of GE Proficy CIMPLICITY. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the gefebt.exe component. This component performs insufficient parameter validation on an HTTP request.
